title: Import Assertions: March Committee Updates
body:
From [the proposal repo](https://github.com/tc39/proposal-import-attributes)

> 2023-03: The proposal is renamed to Import attributes and moves back to Stage 3 (TODO: notes, [slides](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1Abdr54Iflz_4sah2_yX2qS3K09qDJGV84qIZ6pHAqIk/edit#slide=id.p)). The restriction on the cache key is completely removed, and the keyword changes back from assert to with: import { x } from "./mod" with { type: "json" };. For compatibility with existing implementations, the assert keyword will still be supported until it's safe to remove it, if it will ever be.
